# Engineering Handbook

> One standard for how Cloud 12Nine and Q-Labs projects are built: the stack, the workflow, the pipelines, and a kit of files to copy. Every page is plain Markdown at the URL listed. In a repo that follows this handbook, that repo's own CLAUDE.md wins where it differs.

Each rule is labelled Adopted (two or more repos already do it), In use (one repo does it and it works there), Proposed (recommended, awaiting sign-off) or Open (undecided).

## Start

- [README](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/README.md): what this is, the chooser for what you are building, the standard on one page
- [CLAUDE.md](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/CLAUDE.md): how to use and how to change this handbook

## Standards

- [The stack](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/stack.md): one choice per layer, its status and the reason; version baseline; what we do not use
- [Repo contract](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/repo-contract.md): required files, npm script names, README sections, repository settings, folder names
- [Workflow](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/workflow.md): issue first, branch names, red-green-refactor, commit format, pull requests, review, merge
- [Testing](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/testing.md): Vitest, the 100% coverage gate, dependency injection, allowed exclusions, database tests, Playwright
- [CI/CD](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/ci-cd.md): gates, Netlify hosting built on GitHub Actions, split previews, releases, the migrations job, secret names
- [Data](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/data.md): Supabase, browser-direct versus server-only access, table rules, migrations, connection strings, auth
- [Architecture](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/architecture.md): the as-built page, a target page per epic and decision records; when each is required; how a target becomes issues (Proposed)
- [Security](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/security.md): where each secret goes, endpoint rules, fetching user-supplied URLs, model providers
- [UI and Cobalt](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/ui.md): the Cobalt design system, tokens, Tailwind mapping, atomic design, accessibility baseline
- [Front-end checklist](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/frontend-checklist.md): frontendchecklist.io as the quality bar; which priorities are required, what is automated, how agents review, known gaps
- [Agents](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/standards/agents.md): CLAUDE.md as the rulebook, what every agent must do, skills, cloud sessions, AI features in apps

## Blueprints

- [Pick one](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/README.md): comparison table and decision tree; web app versus full-stack app
- [Static site](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/static-site.md): Astro, content collections, Cobalt with no client JavaScript
- [Web app](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/web-app.md): React, Vite, Supabase from the browser with row-level security, Storybook, JSDoc
- [Full-stack app](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/full-stack-app.md): TanStack Start, Drizzle, server-only data access
- [Library](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/library.md): Vite library mode, CSS Modules, Storybook, Changesets, GitHub Packages
- [Functions](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/functions.md): Supabase Edge Functions for APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs and model calls
- [CLI and scripts](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/cli-and-scripts.md): Node tools, shell scripts, Python scripts
- [Not built yet](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/blueprints/other.md): mobile, browser extension, documentation sites; the rule for anything new

## Kit

- [What to copy where](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/README.md): every kit file, its destination, who needs it, and how much of it has been run
- [CLAUDE.md template](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/common/CLAUDE.template.md): the per-repo rulebook to fill in
- [architecture template](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/common/docs/architecture.template.md): `docs/architecture.md`, the system as built
- [architecture target template](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/common/docs/architecture-target.template.md): the plan for one epic
- [decision record template](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/common/docs/decision.template.md): one architecture decision
- [verify skill template](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/common/claude-skill-verify/SKILL.template.md): how to prove a change works at runtime
- [ci.yml](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/workflows/ci.yml): lint, typecheck, coverage, build, end-to-end, migrations
- [deploy-preview.yml](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/workflows/deploy-preview.yml): trusted per-PR preview deploy to Netlify
- [release.yml](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/workflows/release.yml): tag every merge, then migrate and deploy that tag to production; rollback by tag
- [quality.spec.ts](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/kit/e2e/quality.spec.ts): Playwright spec that automates the checkable Front-End Checklist rules

## Skills

- [handbook-audit](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/skills/handbook-audit/SKILL.md): audit the current repository against this handbook; modes quick, full and fix
- [audit.mjs](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/skills/handbook-audit/scripts/audit.mjs): the conformance script the audit runs; Node only, JSON output, exit code for CI
- [handbook-new-project](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/skills/handbook-new-project/SKILL.md): start a new project from a blueprint, step by step

## Status

- [Adoption](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/adoption.md): where each existing repo stands and the suggested order of migration
- [Decisions](https://qiheme.github.io/handbook/decisions.md): every proposed or open choice, with recommendation and runner-up
